design.intent: Learn to pump two rollers, carry that rhythm into a visible gap, then repeat with a quicker pop.
design.signature: Pumping rhythm becomes flight timing; a broad tabletop teaches the motion before the first void.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Teach two readable weight shifts without a failure gap.
Practice crest timing with continuous rollable ground.
One rounded crest prepares the first flight.
Spend learned momentum on a visible gap and long sloped catch.
Settle on the valley floor and rebuild speed gradually.
Repeat the timing in a shorter flight after a clear recovery.
Finish with a readable three-beat rhythm, then clear runout.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
